text:
Priya: Quick sync — vendor asked for a single-tenant publisher account path plus IAM bootstrap for AWS/GCP/Azure. Who owns the initial role wiring?
Liam: I can take AWS/GCP role templates. Need to confirm naming convention for tenant roles (we used rw-pub-<org>-role last time).
Hannah: +1 on naming. Also want guidance on branding assets upload — publisher wants to show logo + short blurb on store. Any constraints (size, svg/png, text length)?
Jorge: For Azure we need Publisher Tenant + Offer ID early. I can map the AMI/VM image IDs once we have the account. Also: are we supporting bring-your-own-credentials for private images?
Priya: Good questions. From product: 1) role name format = redwood-pub-<tenant_slug>-svc 2) branding: logo 240x80 PNG or 72px square SVG, description <= 400 chars. I'll put these in the onboarding doc.
Ella (Legal): EULA and regional terms: we must include EU data processing clause if tenant requests EU-only. Also we need to flag any export-controlled use cases — fill the legal intake form before publish.
Liam: I'll drop the IAM CloudFormation and TF snippets into the publisher repo. Quick CFN snippet:```yaml
Resources:
  PubRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: redwood-pub-${TenantSlug}-svc
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument: >-
        { /* trust policy */ }
```
Hannah: For branding flow, add a small validation step in portal to reject >400 chars and non-approved file types. Also add a preview URL.
Jorge: For Azure, I'll need a list of required Offer metadata fields. Priya, can you confirm if SKU mapping will be 1:1 with our internal plan ids?
Priya: Yes SKU mapping will match plan_ids for billing mapping. We'll share a mapping CSV after legal signoff.
Ella (Legal): I'll send the legal intake link here: https://redwood.internal/legal/publisher-intake and will review EU clause requests within 48h.
OpsBot: Reminder: onboarding checklist created (https://redwood.internal/onboard/checklists/pub-tenant) — steps added: create tenant role, upload branding, map SKU, legal intake.
Liam: Timeline: I can have IAM templates + README by EOD tomorrow. Will ping when pushed.
Hannah: I'll prototype the branding preview component and wire the file validation by Thursday.
Jorge: Azure offer metadata list request posted to the doc in #partnerships — added required fields and example manifest.
Priya: Great — next sync if needed Friday afternoon. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here and tag me. :rocket:
